source_registry.publisher: Evernorth Holdings Inc. via SEC EDGAR
source_registry.authority: Issuer Form 10-Q attached to Form 424B3 prospectus supplement
claims_supported: As of 2026-09-30, Evernorth held 346,284,972 XRP with historical cost of approximately $846.575 million.
The filing reports $214.05 million of advance-funding cash used to purchase 84,365,876 XRP and 261,919,096 XRP contributed under private-placement subscriptions.
Unrestricted cash was $91,397 at 2026-09-30; Evernorth's $1.0 million revolving facility was undrawn; $3.6 million was payable to Pathfinder for operating costs paid on Evernorth's behalf.
Cumulative impairment was approximately $504.688 million and accounting carrying value approximately $341.887 million.

Evernorth had not generated revenue as of 2026-09-30; nine-month net loss was approximately $32.9 million, while Q3 reported net income was primarily affected by accounting movements including changes in fair value of refundable investor advances.
At the October 9 close, aggregate gross cash proceeds were approximately $272.6 million before transaction expenses and investors contributed approximately 388,910,554 XRP in kind.
Between October 12 and November 9, holders exercised 3,073,366 warrants for cash and Evernorth received approximately $35.3 million gross; 8,666,279 warrants remained outstanding.

source_registry.publisher: Evernorth Holdings Inc. via SEC EDGAR
claims_supported: The filing corrects a clerical error in the prior closing report's share count.
Evernorth reported SBI Holdings, Inc. beneficial ownership of 9,431,914 Class A shares and 2,359,038 Class C shares.
Total shares outstanding at closing were 23,638,882 Class A and 31,392,746 Class C; the SBI figures equal 39.9% of Class A and 7.5% of Class C respectively.
The 39.9% figure is a Class A ownership percentage, not 39.9% of the entire company.

source_registry.publisher: Evernorth Holdings Inc. via SEC EDGAR
claims_supported: The optional committed equity facility covers up to 5,218,935 Class A shares.
Purchases are made at 97% of applicable VWAP subject to contractual conditions and issuer purchase notices.
The company may receive proceeds from shares sold to Cantor under the Purchase Agreement; the prospectus does not establish that the full facility or any specific amount has been drawn.
SBI announced a $200 million cash contribution to Evernorth's PIPE, primarily intended for XRP purchases.
The later SEC closing disclosures confirm SBI Holdings beneficial ownership but do not provide a separate investor-level cash reconciliation for SBI's exact funded amount.
SBI Holdings' FY2025 presentation describes Ripple as an SBI Group investee and reports an approximately 9% equity stake as of the presentation date.
Ripple and SBI Holdings, through SBI VC Trade, announced RLUSD availability in Japan after JFSA approval.
The distribution channel is SBI VC Trade, a subsidiary of SBI Holdings; this is not a relationship with the separate regional SBIC companies.
RLUSD became available through Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Retail, with support across XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Ripple's announcement says Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support would follow; the release does not establish that RLUSD collateral was already active there on October 28.
Ripple reported RLUSD market capitalization of approximately $2.4 billion in this release; this is issuer-reported and time-specific.
BNY is primary reserve custodian for RLUSD and has a custody relationship with Ripple Prime.
BNY announced support for XRP and RLUSD on its Digital Asset Custody platform.
Tokenized trade-finance exploration is a future intention subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals, not proof of a live XRPL trade-finance product.
Circle states USDC is natively supported on 38 blockchain networks as of September 16, 2026, including XRPL.
Circle states the Circle Reserve Fund portfolio is custodied at BNY and managed by BlackRock; this does not mean BNY holds every USDC reserve asset.
Circle remains the issuer of USDC after the Centre governance structure ended.
Circle announced that Coinbase took an equity stake in Circle and that both parties continue to share USDC reserve interest income under their agreement.
Circle announced native USDC availability on XRPL mainnet through Circle Mint and Circle APIs.
This establishes Circle-issued USDC on XRPL, not a direct Ripple-Circle corporate partnership.

capital_interpretation: $214.05 million was actual historical cash received and used to acquire 84,365,876 XRP; it is not current free cash.
The 261.919 million investor XRP subscription amount and Ripple's 126.791 million XRP contribution were in-kind, not contemporaneous open-market purchases.
The approximately 388.911 million XRP in-kind closing amount includes investor contributions, delayed-funding XRP and Ripple's contribution.
The approximately $272.6 million closing cash figure is gross proceeds before transaction expenses; it is not a current cash balance.
The $30 million PIK note is debt. Warrant exercises produced approximately $35.3 million gross cash through November 9. Neither proves that proceeds were spent on XRP.
The Cantor ELOC is optional share-issuance capacity. The reviewed November 17 prospectus does not establish a draw or actual proceeds.
The $504.688 million impairment is an accounting write-down, not proof of an XRP sale or an equivalent cash outflow.

source_disagreements_and_limits: The October 12 Evernorth 8-K corrects a clerical share-count error in the prior closing report; use the corrected SBI Holdings beneficial-ownership figures.
SBI's $200 million PIPE announcement and the SEC's aggregate private-placement cash are not an investor-level cash reconciliation; exact SBI cash funded remains unresolved.

BNY's October 27 RLUSD market-cap statement (~$2.5 billion) and Ripple's October 28 statement (~$2.6 billion) are issuer-reported, date-specific rounded values; do not treat the difference as a contradiction or precise market feed.
Evernorth's September 30 cash balance predates the October 9 business-combination close and later note/warrant proceeds; it is not the current post-close cash balance.
The SEC 10-Q and 8-K are filings by the same issuer and are not independent issuer corroboration, even though they are separate filings.

Ripple's October 28 announcement reports final OCC approval for a National Trust Bank charter; no OCC primary confirmation was captured in this research run, so retain it as an issuer statement pending regulator-source verification.

hypotheses_and_counterevidence.hypothesis: Evernorth's approximately 473.3 million XRP treasury demonstrates institutional XRP demand.
support: The combined Pathfinder reconciliation is approximately 473.276 million XRP.
The company reported $214.05 million cash used to purchase 84.366 million XRP.
counterevidence: Approximately 388.911 million XRP was contributed in kind at closing, including investor and Ripple contributions.
The exact exchange venues and execution timestamps for the $214.05 million XRP purchases were not disclosed in the reviewed filing.
The full treasury amount is not equivalent to contemporaneous open-market buy pressure.

hypotheses_and_counterevidence.hypothesis: Ripple's 126.791 million XRP contribution could create operating-liquidity supply if liquidated.
support: The filing says the XRP contributed to Pathfinder is available to fund operating costs.
counterevidence: No specific sale or exchange deposit is established by this evidence.

hypotheses_and_counterevidence.hypothesis: RLUSD and USDC distribution growth could increase XRP demand.
support: RLUSD distribution is expanding through Coinbase and SBI VC Trade; USDC is native on XRPL; BNY supports XRP and RLUSD custody.
counterevidence: Stablecoin growth and custody availability do not require XRP as a bridge asset or collateral.
Coinbase RLUSD collateral support was announced as future, not active in the October 28 release.
No direct Circle-Ripple partnership is established.

hypotheses_and_counterevidence.hypothesis: Evernorth's $504.688 million impairment indicates equivalent realized XRP selling pressure.
counterevidence: The filing reports impairment accounting and does not establish a corresponding XRP sale or cash outflow.
